# Imprint
Imprint is a modern financial platform that powers **co-branded credit cards, deposit accounts, and installment loans** for leading brands. Our financial products attract more users, drive increased spend and engagement, and provide brands with deeper insights into their customers.  

With **Imprint Core**, we’ve built a credit card platform from the ground up that delivers complete control over every sign-up, swipe, rewards redemption, and transaction. Brands can tailor their financial programs to align with their ambitions, while relying on Imprint’s scalable, reliable technology and underwriting expertise.  

## Products
- **Co-Branded Credit Cards**: Bespoke credit card programs that deepen brand relationships, attract new users, and deliver tailored rewards.  
- **Deposit Accounts**: Integrated account experiences that extend brand loyalty and provide customers with more ways to engage.  
- **Installment Loans**: Flexible installment offerings to enhance customer purchasing power and drive spend.  
- **Imprint Core**: The full-stack platform that powers issuance, rewards, transactions, and program management, all customizable to a brand’s needs.  

## Technology & Performance
Imprint’s infrastructure is designed for speed, reliability, and scale:  
- **3X faster** than industry average for application decisioning  
- **2 seconds** average application decision time  
- **99.77%** non-crash rate (iOS & Android)  
- **99.77%** backend critical services uptime  
- **12,999,946+** transactions processed (and counting)  
- **24/7** on-call engineering support  

## Partner Ecosystem
Imprint is the financial partner of choice for **iconic global brands**, including:  
- Turkish Airlines  
- H-E-B  
- Booking.com  
- Horizon Hobby  
- Holiday Inn Club Vacations  
- World of Westgate  
- Brooks Brothers  
- Eddie Bauer  
- Rakuten  
- Fetch  

All cards are issued under license from Visa, Mastercard, or American Express, and powered by **Imprint Payments, Inc.**
